mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior 5 days is followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals economic weakness that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% in a month but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of such triggered months over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI and FEDFUNDS signal aggressive monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in HOUST is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions, which support corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth in the prior 5 days is followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a month, it signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100.0 in a month is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-constrained periods, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained periods, a decline in INDPRO is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases over a 5-year period.
